posts.title: My First CVE and Thoughts on Cybersecurity Work
posts.description: Finishing my first public CVE advisory, I’ll admit it’s a lot of work for little glamour. Administrators are told to upgrade to a patched version, and most won’t give the vulnerability’s complexity or severity a second thought.
